articles.summary: Trained on what developers choose on 21st, Qwen started filling the screen, adding colour and building a whole page around one component.
articles.title: Can a model learn developer taste in UI?

articles.summary: We showed 11 models 200 pairs of components from 21st and asked which one developers chose more often for their projects. Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 did best, and all of them prefer the plain option where developers go for gradients, glow and 3D.
articles.title: AI models predict which UI components developers choose, up to 70% of the time
